name: Egg fried rice
steps: Rinse the rice, add 300 ml water and cook it in the rice cooker. Let it cool a little.
Heat the oil in a pan on medium heat (a drop of water should sizzle). Add chopped garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the frozen veg straight from the freezer and stir for 4 minutes until hot. Chop them small with your spoon so they hide in the rice.
Push everything aside, crack in the eggs and stir until set and no longer runny.
Add the rice and soy sauce, stir for 2 minutes.
batch: Cook a double batch. Keeps 3 days in the fridge and reheats well in a microwave.

name: Chicken and rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice in the rice cooker with 300 ml water.
Cut the chicken into 2 cm pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a pan on medium heat. Add the chicken and cook 6–8 minutes, turning, until no pink is left inside. Cut one piece open to check.
Add the frozen veg and cook 4 more minutes, stirring.
Serve over the rice.
batch: Make 4 portions at once. Chicken stays moist when reheated if you add a splash of water.

name: Simple chicken curry with rice
steps: Start the rice in the rice cooker with 450 ml water.
Chop the onion and garlic. Heat the oil in a pot on medium heat and cook the onion 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and curry powder, stir 1 minute.
Add the chicken in chunks, tomatoes and frozen veg. Bring to a gentle bubble, cover and cook 15 minutes on low.
Mash the veg into the sauce with your spoon so they disappear. Chicken is done when white all the way through. Serve with rice.
batch: Curry tastes better the next day. Freeze extra portions for up to 2 months.

name: Tuna omelette
steps: Beat the eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a pan on medium heat.
Pour in the eggs. When the edges set (about 1 minute), spread the tuna over one half.
Cook 2 more minutes until the top is no longer runny, fold in half and slide onto a plate.
batch: Best fresh. For work, use the boiled eggs batch instead.

name: Dhal with rice and boiled eggs
steps: Put the eggs in a pot of cold water, bring to the boil, then boil 9 minutes. Cool in cold water and peel.
Start the rice in the rice cooker with 300 ml water.
Cook chopped onion and garlic in the oil on medium heat for 5 minutes. Add turmeric.
Add rinsed lentils, frozen veg and 600 ml water. Simmer 15–20 minutes, stirring, until thick and mushy. Mash the veg in.
Add salt to taste. Serve with rice and 2 eggs each.
batch: Dhal freezes well. Keep eggs separate and peel them just before packing.

name: Pan-fried fish with potatoes and vegetables
steps: Cut the potatoes into 2 cm cubes. Boil in salted water 12 minutes until a fork goes in easily. Drain.
Pat the fish dry with a towel and sprinkle with salt.
Heat the oil in a pan on medium-high. Cook the fish 3–4 minutes per side. It is done when it flakes easily with a fork.
Microwave the veg for 3 minutes. Serve everything with a squeeze of lemon.
batch: Fish is best the same day. Cook extra potatoes for next day's packed meal.

name: Yoghurt, banana and nuts bowl
steps: Spoon the yoghurt into a container.
Slice the banana on top.
Add the nuts. Eat cold.
batch: Pack nuts separately so they stay crunchy.

name: Peanut-butter banana oats
steps: Put oats and milk in a pot on medium-low heat.
Stir for 4–5 minutes until thick and creamy.
Mash in half the banana, stir in the peanut butter, slice the rest on top.
batch: Make 3 portions and microwave 90 seconds with a splash of milk.

name: Lentil soup
steps: Cook chopped onion and garlic in the oil on medium heat for 5 minutes. Add cumin.
Add rinsed lentils, frozen veg and the water.
Simmer 20 minutes until the lentils fall apart.
Blend with a stick blender, or mash well, so the veg disappear. Add salt to taste.
batch: Freezes for 2 months. Reheat in a work microwave for 2–3 minutes, stirring halfway.

name: Chicken wrap
steps: Shred the cooked chicken with two forks.
Mix with the yoghurt and salt.
Spread on the wraps, add lettuce, fold in the sides and roll up tight.
batch: Cook extra chicken breast earlier in the week. Eat cold or warm the filling only.

name: Boiled eggs batch
steps: Put the eggs in a pot, cover with cold water and bring to the boil.
Boil 9 minutes for firm eggs.
Move to cold water for 5 minutes, then keep them in their shells in the fridge.
batch: Lasts 5 days in the fridge. 2 eggs is one serving.

name: Tuna sandwich
steps: Mix the tuna and mayonnaise in a bowl.
Spread on one slice, add lettuce, top with the other slice and cut in half.
batch: Make it the night before and keep it in the fridge.
